hotel.name: The Grand Azure Resort & Spa
hotel.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours prior to check-in (3:00 PM local time). Cancellations made within 48 hours of arrival incur a fee equal to the first night's room rate plus tax.
hotel.breakfast_policy: Breakfast buffet is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM in the Azure Bay Dining Room. It costs $25 per adult and $15 per child under 12. Complimentary full daily breakfast is included for all guests staying in Executive Harbor Suites and Two-Bedroom Family Villas.
hotel.meal_policy: Lunch and dinner are not included in the standard room rates. Only breakfast is included complimentary for guests in Executive Harbor Suites and Two-Bedroom Family Villas (or available for purchase at $25/adult). Lunch and dinner are available à la carte at our three on-site restaurants: Azure Bay (coastal fine dining), The Tide Bar & Lounge, and Seaside Cafe, or via 24-hour room service.

amenities.name: Rooftop Heated Infinity Pool
amenities.description: Heated rooftop infinity pool with panoramic ocean views, open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Complimentary private cabanas and towel service are available.

amenities.name: 24/7 Wellness Fitness Center & Spa
amenities.description: State-of-the-art 24/7 fitness center on the 3rd floor equipped with Peloton bikes, LifeFitness treadmills, free weights, and a yoga studio. Azure Spa offers massage and hydrotherapy treatments from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM.

amenities.name: High-Speed Fiber Wi-Fi
amenities.description: Complimentary ultra-high-speed fiber Wi-Fi (up to 300 Mbps) is available throughout all guest rooms, lobby, pool deck, and restaurants. No password required; connect to 'GrandAzure-Guest' and accept terms.

amenities.name: Valet Parking & EV Charging
amenities.description: Secure valet parking is available for $35 per overnight stay with unlimited in-and-out privileges. Complimentary Level 2 Tesla and universal J1772 EV charging stations are available for valet vehicles.

amenities.name: On-Site Dining & Cocktail Lounge
amenities.description: Three dining venues: 'Azure Bay' (coastal California fine dining, 5:30 PM - 10:00 PM), 'The Tide Bar & Lounge' (cocktails & coastal bites, 11:00 AM - 12:00 AM), and 'Seaside Cafe' (espresso & fresh pastries, 6:30 AM - 3:00 PM). Room service is available 24 hours.

rooms.name: Deluxe King Room
rooms.description: Spacious 380 sq ft room featuring an ultra-comfortable plush King pillow-top bed, private balcony with garden views, marble walk-in rain shower, 55-inch smart 4K TV, and Nespresso machine.

rooms.name: Deluxe Double Queen Room
rooms.description: Generous 450 sq ft room designed for families or traveling groups of up to 4 guests (also ideal for 3 guests). Includes two plush Queen beds, spacious seating area, dual-sink vanity bathroom, and mini-refrigerator.

rooms.name: Executive Harbor Suite
rooms.bedConfig: 1 King Bed + 1 Queen Pullout Sofa Bed
rooms.description: Luxurious 620 sq ft suite featuring a separate master bedroom with 1 King bed and a living parlor with a premium Queen pullout sleeper sofa, comfortably accommodating 3 adult guests. Includes ocean/harbor views, deep soaking tub, complimentary daily breakfast, and late checkout priority.

rooms.name: Two-Bedroom Family Villa
rooms.bedConfig: 1 King Bed + 2 Twin Beds + 1 Queen Sleeper Sofa
rooms.description: Expansive 950 sq ft multi-room villa ideal for larger families and groups up to 6 guests. Features 2 private bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, fully-equipped kitchenette with dining area, private furnished ocean-facing patio, and complimentary daily breakfast.

faqs.question: What time is check-in and check-out?
faqs.answer: Check-in begins at 3:00 PM, and check-out is by 11:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out may be arranged based on availability upon request at the front desk.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have a swimming pool?
faqs.answer: Yes, we feature a heated rooftop infinity pool offering panoramic ocean views. The pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM with complimentary cabanas and towel service.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
faqs.answer: Breakfast is complimentary for guests staying in Executive Harbor Suites and Two-Bedroom Family Villas. For Deluxe King and Deluxe Double Queen guests, our gourmet buffet at Azure Bay is available for $25 per adult and $15 per child under 12.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: You may cancel free of charge up to 48 hours prior to your scheduled check-in time (3:00 PM). Cancellations received within 48 hours of arrival will be charged the first night's room rate plus tax.

faqs.question: Which room is suitable for three guests?
faqs.answer: For three guests, we recommend either the Executive Harbor Suite (1 King bed + 1 Queen pullout sofa bed, plus complimentary breakfast) or the Deluxe Double Queen Room (2 Queen beds, accommodating up to 4 guests comfortably).

faqs.question: Are pets allowed at the hotel?
faqs.answer: Yes, we welcome up to two dogs per room under 25 lbs each. A non-refundable pet cleaning fee of $75 per stay applies. Certified service animals are always accommodated with no fee.

faqs.question: Is parking available, and how much does it cost?
faqs.answer: We offer secure valet parking for $35 per overnight stay with unlimited in-and-out privileges. Complimentary Level 2 Tesla and universal EV charging stations are available for valet vehicles.

faqs.question: Do you offer airport transportation or shuttles?
faqs.answer: We do not have a complimentary airport shuttle, but our concierge can arrange private town car or taxi transfers to Monterey Regional Airport (MRY) and San Jose International (SJC).

faqs.question: Can I store my luggage before check-in or after check-out?
faqs.answer: Yes, complimentary secure luggage storage is available with our bell desk 24 hours a day, both before check-in and after check-out.

faqs.question: Is the hotel smoke-free?
faqs.answer: The Grand Azure Resort is a 100% non-smoking property. Smoking, including e-cigarettes and vaping, is strictly prohibited in all guest rooms, balconies, and indoor public spaces.

faqs.question: Are lunch and dinner included in the room rate or room budget?
faqs.answer: No, lunch and dinner are not included in the room rate or room budget. Only breakfast is included for select room types (complimentary for Executive Harbor Suites and Two-Bedroom Family Villas, or $25 per adult for other rooms). Guests can enjoy lunch and dinner à la carte at our three on-site restaurants (Azure Bay, The Tide Bar & Lounge, and Seaside Cafe) or via 24-hour room service.

faqs.question: What meals are included with a room booking?
faqs.answer: Only breakfast is included (complimentary for guests staying in Executive Harbor Suites and Two-Bedroom Family Villas, or $25 per adult for Deluxe rooms). Lunch, dinner, snacks, and alcoholic beverages are not included in room rates and are billed separately.
